params.passed: True if the proposal passed inside the TEE enclave tally.
params.proposalId: ID of the proposal to resolve.
params.teeProof: Cryptographic attestation proof / signature generated inside Intel TDX TEE hardware enclave.
params.totalAgainst: Total aggregated vote weight AGAINST the proposal.
params.totalFor: Total aggregated vote weight FOR the proposal.

grantAgentViewingRights(address,uint256).details: Delegates access to the proposal's Master Access Key (`proposalAccessKeys[proposalId]`) instead of looping over thousands of individual vote handles.

params.agent: Address of the Leno AI agent enclave.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

castVote(uint256,bool).notice: Casts a confidential vote on a proposal, burning 10 cGUILD (`VOTE_COST`).

createProposal(string).notice: Creates a confidential proposal, burning 500 cGUILD (`PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD`) to eliminate spam.

executeProposalResult(uint256,bool,uint2.notice: Executes and resolves a proposal after off-chain TEE tally calculation.

getVoteHandlesCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of vote handles recorded for a proposal.

grantAgentViewingRights(address,uint256).notice: O(1) Gas Optimization: Grants viewing rights to an authorized Leno AI agent in exactly 1 transaction.
